caseName: U.S. Army Corp of Eng'rs v. Hawkes Co.
caseNameFull: UNITED STATES ARMY CORP OF ENGINEERS v. HAWKES CO., INC.

opinions.text: Motion of National Association of Home Builders for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit granted.
